High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Ket Maliss (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Ket Maliss _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xuIjoKP2yYxtGIeo7hrev2mnYnNwibsN/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Ket Maliss _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,456 bytes, SHA-256 <code>df86cc4cccfda914708cc67703d7982e340a4aa5d603b2b2ead6b4dd7dd54027</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Premiere-D-ketmaliss.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
